senses.gloss: f. (סְרַס; cmp. סוּרְסִי) mutilated or reduced coin.
units: <cite ref="Bekhorot 49b:12">Bekh. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>אסתירא ס׳ וכ׳</he> (Rashi <cite ref="O00376"><he>סוסריתא</he></cite>, <cite ref="O00274"><he>סווסריתא</he></cite>; Tosaf. <he>ססוירייא</he>, prob. meant for <he>סוּרְסָיָא</he> or <he>סוּרְסִיתָא</he>) a battered or reduced Istira, eight of which sell for a Denar.
